preamble.summary: Proverbs 4 is a father's three-fold instruction on the WAY: acquire wisdom (vv. 1–9), walk in wisdom's path (vv. 10–19), and guard your heart-and-mouth-and-eyes-and-feet (vv. 20–27). Verse 23's 'keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life' is one of the Psalter's most-cited interior-ethics axioms.
preamble.notable_variants: 4:18 'the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn' as morning-star eschatology (cf. 2 Pet 1:19); 4:23 'keep your heart with all vigilance' classic interior-ethics; 4:25–27 eyes-forward / feet-straight — discipleship-path.

variant_notes: 'Hear, O sons, a father's instruction, and be attentive, that you may gain insight' tracks MT.
'For I give you good precepts; do not forsake my teaching' tracks MT.
'When I was a son with my father, tender, the only one in the sight of my mother' tracks MT. INTER-GENERATIONAL chain — the teacher was once a student.

'He taught me and said to me: Let your heart hold fast my words; keep my commandments, and live' tracks MT. HOLD-FAST-TO-WORDS. John 8:31 ('if you abide in my word, you are truly my disciples') Christologically extends.
'Get wisdom; get insight; do not forget, and do not turn away from the words of my mouth' tracks MT.
'Do not forsake her, and she will keep you; love her, and she will guard you' tracks MT. LOVE-HER — Wisdom-as-beloved. 1 Corinthians 1:30 ('Christ our wisdom') Christologically extends.
'The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom, and whatever you get, get insight' tracks MT.
'Prize her highly, and she will exalt you; she will honor you if you embrace her' tracks MT.

'She will place on your head a graceful garland; she will bestow on you a beautiful crown' tracks MT. GRACEFUL-GARLAND — crown-of-wisdom. 2 Timothy 4:8 ('the crown of righteousness') and James 1:12 ('crown of life') extend.
'Hear, my son, and accept my words, that the years of your life may be many' tracks MT.
'I have taught you the way of wisdom; I have led you in the paths of uprightness' tracks MT. THE-WAY-OF-WISDOM. John 14:6's 'I am the way' Christologically fulfills.
'When you walk, your step will not be hampered, and if you run, you will not stumble' tracks MT.
'Keep hold of instruction; do not let go; guard her, for she is your life' tracks MT.
'Do not enter the path of the wicked, and do not walk in the way of the evil' tracks MT. PATH-OF-WICKED avoidance.
'Avoid it; do not go on it; turn away from it and pass on' tracks MT.
'For they cannot sleep unless they have done wrong; they are robbed of sleep unless they have made someone stumble' tracks MT. CANNOT-SLEEP-UNLESS-WICKED — the wicked's compulsion toward evil.
'For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence' tracks MT. BREAD-AND-WINE-OF-VIOLENCE — the wicked's dark-Eucharist parody.

'But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, which shines brighter and brighter until full day' tracks MT. PATH-OF-RIGHTEOUS-LIKE-DAWN. 2 Peter 1:19 ('until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts') and Matthew 5:16 ('let your light shine before others') extend.
'The way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know over what they stumble' tracks MT.
'My son, be attentive to my words; incline your ear to my sayings' tracks MT.
'Let them not escape from your sight; keep them within your heart' tracks MT.

'For they are life to those who find them, and healing to all their flesh' tracks MT. WORDS-AS-LIFE-AND-HEALING. John 6:63 ('the words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life') Christologically extends.

'Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life' tracks MT. KEEP-YOUR-HEART. Classic interior-ethics axiom. Matthew 15:18–19 ('what comes out of the mouth proceeds from the heart … evil thoughts, murder, adultery') develops the heart-as-moral-source theology. Luke 6:45 ('the good person out of the good treasure of his heart produces good, and the evil person out of his evil treasure produces evil').

'Put away from you crooked speech, and put devious talk far from you' tracks MT. SPEECH-ETHICS. Ephesians 4:25 ('put away falsehood, let each one of you speak the truth'), 4:29 ('let no corrupting talk come out of your mouths') extend.
'Let your eyes look directly forward, and your gaze be straight before you' tracks MT. EYES-FORWARD discipleship-posture.
'Ponder the path of your feet; then all your ways will be sure' tracks MT.

'Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your foot away from evil' tracks MT. RIGHT-AND-LEFT swerve-prohibition. Deuteronomy 5:32, 17:11, 17:20 share the 'not turn aside to the right or to the left' formula.
